ticks.note: Power on: the first visit to `On` starts in `Home` (0).

Back to `Settings` with history. `MenuNested`: surprise, `Settings` starts again in `Brightness` (11). `On` is not the target of a history transition, so KIELER silently treats `go to Settings history` as a plain `go to Settings`. `MenuNestedFixed`: `On` is a history target (from `Off`), so the history inside it works: `Contrast` (12).

Power on. `MenuNested` starts `On` in `Home` (0). `MenuNestedFixed` enters `On` with `shallow history`, so it resumes in `Settings`, which starts again in `Brightness` (11). The fix changed what switching on does.
